title: Final notice: Meridian Trade Holdings Ltd (in administration)
body:
The Financial Conduct Authority has published a final notice in respect of Meridian Trade
Holdings Ltd, a commodity trading firm incorporated in the British Virgin Islands.

The notice records that the firm failed to maintain adequate systems and controls over
client money between March 2021 and September 2023. The firm agreed to pay a financial
penalty of 1,240,000 pounds and to cease regulated activity.

The FCA found no evidence of dishonesty by any director. The notice states that the conduct
was characterised as negligent rather than deliberate.
